comment: Example for the 'ssh' sandbox backend (remote host over your tailnet). Copy the backends.ssh block into ~/.memory/config/sandbox.json and fill in real values. Project config/ is read-only at runtime.
notes: host: SSH destination. Prefer the Tailscale MagicDNS name or 100.x address so traffic stays on the tailnet.
url_host: what MoJo dials over HTTP for the opencode API. Defaults to host. Set only when the ssh alias differs from the routable name.
bind_host: opencode --hostname on the remote. 0.0.0.0 is safe behind the tailnet plus per-task random BasicAuth password; use the remote's tailscale IP to be stricter.
SSH must work non-interactively (key auth); the backend runs ssh with BatchMode=yes.
Remote host needs: bash, ss (iproute2), and either bun or curl for the one-time opencode install.
Run a task with sandbox_backend=ssh in its config, e.g.: scheduler add task with config {"sandbox_backend": "ssh", "working_dir": "~/projects/bizbuild", "git_url": "..."}
